title: S07 · Press ready lamp (factory cell, transient cue)
task: Task: unload the part after the curing cycle ends, within 90 s. The only sign is the READY lamp, which lights for 6 s.
change: While it thinks, the cycle ends and the lamp blinks. Afterwards the press looks exactly as before.

events.lamp_on: the READY lamp lights up (for 6 s)
